summary: Reconstructed an XDK-free <xtl.h> header set. All 19 files that #include <xtl.h> (11 .c that include it directly + net_upnp.c transitively = 12 TUs compiled to .obj, plus 8 headers exercised transitively) build clean with cl.exe 16.00.11886.00 under wibo. Every .obj is machine 0x01F2 (PowerPC BE). Only residual diagnostic is warning C4392 from LIBCMT/va_list_def.h (pre-existing, out of lane scope).
residual_warnings: C4392 (LIBCMT va_list_def.h __va_start intrinsic arg-count) — pre-existing LIBCMT issue, benign, 1 per TU
caveats: Lane scope is COMPILE correctness. Import symbols declared here (XNet*, Xam*, XContent*, XInput*, CreateThread, etc.) are resolved at LINK by Lane L's import libs and at LOAD by the console kernel — not defined in these headers.

Runtime STRUCT-LAYOUT correctness (Risk #3) is only spot-verified for dereferenced structs against public XDK/free60/Xenia layouts (XNADDR, XINPUT_GAMEPAD, XCONTENT_DATA/CROSS_TITLE_DATA, XDEVICE_DATA, XNQOS/XNQOSINFO, sockaddr_in/IN_ADDR, XSESSION_*). The PPC _CONTEXT here uses 64-bit Xenon GPRs with named Gpr0..Gpr31; the exact byte offsets of Iar/Lr/Msr/Gpr1 used by xbox360_exceptions.c's stackwalk should be validated against a stock crash dump before trusting the runtime dump. EXCEPTION_CONTEXT_SIZE is a fixed 560 in RB3E's exceptions.h, independent of sizeof(CONTEXT).

RB3E's own xbox360.h declares MmIsAddressValid, XexGetModuleHandle/ProcedureAddress, RtlInitAnsiString, ObCreateSymbolicLink, the XeCrypt/XeKeys functions, STRING, and XNetLogonGetExtendedStatus — the xdk-oss headers intentionally do NOT redeclare these to avoid conflicts.
